title: Huawei says it built a 505B model on its own chips, no Nvidia - TCR 08/02/26
description:
Huawei says it trained openPangu-2.0-Pro, a 505-billion-parameter open-weight model, entirely on its own Ascend NPUs with no Nvidia silicon in the run, the European Commission opened bidding for seven AI gigafactory hubs holding up to 100,000 chips each, and South Korea widened a $13.9 billion sovereign fund to buy into domestic AI infrastructure.

https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-august-2-2026/

0:00 Open and framing
0:27 Huawei trains a frontier model with no Nvidia
4:40 EU opens bidding for seven AI gigafactories
7:35 Reddit fights AI value compression on two fronts
11:09 Berkeley's 48-sensor microscope breaks optics' oldest trade-off
13:32 Close

This episode covers Huawei's claimed no-Nvidia frontier model and the reportedly dwindling foreign die bank underneath it, the EU's seven-hub gigafactory program and Korea's sovereign AI fund, Belgium backing a Congo germanium plant supplying 15% of world demand, Reddit's dual-front fight against Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews, and a UC Berkeley 48-sensor microscope capturing 25.2 billion pixels per second.

Note: Multiple times in the Reddit vs. SerpApi and Perplexity segment I incorrectly refer to SerpApi as "SerpAI". 

The day's spine is the assumption that value concentrates and stays concentrated meeting evidence it does not. Huawei climbed the export fence and routed around it at the same moment, willing an entire parallel stack of fabrication, memory, interconnect, and open weights into existence beneath the top of the market. Europe and Seoul moved to own the physical substrate of frontier compute rather than keep renting it from three American hyperscalers, while Belgium loosened a single country's grip on a chip-critical mineral. Reddit tested whether the human conversation an answer layer summarizes for free can be repriced by the people who made it, clearing in court the bar Google's own scraping suit missed. And a Berkeley team displaced precision optics with 48 commodity sensors and reconstruction code, imaging living organisms at cellular detail across a five-centimeter field at video speed. Each front shows capability passing from a handful of gatekeepers toward a widening set of hands.
